spatially-resolved photoluminescence measurements of InGaN light-emitting diode (LED) revealed sub-micron-scale inhomogeneities in the PL intensity and peak wavelength.

we found spatially resolved PL inhomogeneities and their correlations with the emission wavelength for yellow-green and an amber LED, and proposed a possible carrier dynamic model based on the localization effect in InGaN/GaAs quantum wells.

we investigated the spatially-resolved PL of InGaN LED with yellow-green and amber light, which revealed the correlation between PL intensities, and peak wavelength, and proposed the possible carrier dynamics model.

the spatially resolved PL measurements of InGaN quantum wells and the carrier dynamics model for the optical properties of InGaN light-emitting diode.
a fundamental understanding of the carrier dynamics and optical properties in InGaN/GaNGaN-based LEDs with various emission wavelengths.
the spatially resolved optical properties of InGaN LED active layers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a spatial distribution of the indium composition in an active layer should strongly affect the optical properties of InGaN quantum-well-based LEDs.

the carrier dynamics in InGaN/Gan/AlGaN quantum-well structured LEDs should be very complicated, and the carrier dynamics in the active layers should be very important in determining the optical properties and the emission efficiency.
the carrier dynamics in InGaN-based LEDs should be very important to explain the origin of their optical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the spatially resolved PL measurement is a very useful tool to investigate the carrier dynamics of InGaN active layer and the origin of the emission efficiency degradation of InGaN LED with high indium compositions.
the carrier dynamics in InGaN LEDs is very complicated due to the presence of indium composition fluctuation and carrier localization in the active layers.
the optical properties of InGaN active layer are very important in determining the optical characteristics of InGaN LED.
